content: {"episode_id":"ep-05015","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management."}
